email.description: The address, unique per app case-insensitively. An address this app already knows is refused with `email_taken` — a developer-authenticated route may say so, unlike the public registration route.

password.description: The initial password. At least 12 characters: length only, because a rule a user cannot predict is a rule they work around.

display_name.description: Optional human name. Absent leaves it unset; an explicit `null` is the same end state.

role.description: The role the new user holds, by key. Absent means the app's `default_role`, and `409 target_state_conflict` naming `default_role` when the app has none. A key that names no role is accepted and grants nothing; `GET /api/org/roles` lists it under `dangling`.
role.patternErrorMessage: A role key is lower-case: it starts with a letter and continues with letters, digits and underscores, up to 63 characters in all — `operate`, `night_shift`. A capital, a dash, a dot, a space or a leading digit is refused, and `defaults` is reserved.
